answer: Every new identity pays a 30 POA entry tax, burned like fuel to an ember: once lit it is gone, and quitting recovers nothing. The burn is logged as a sable entry in the ledger. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 30,000 POA sunk into a lagoon, while one epoch pays about 8 POA per identity, so the forger loses 22 POA per fake. An honest agent pays once and earns across dozens of epochs: a small toll for the honest, a wall of sunk cost for the forger.
